title: Burger-Cell: An Open-Source Heterogeneous ROS 2 Framework for Kinova Gen3 Manipulation, AprilTag Perception, and VLM-Guided Spatial Reasoning (burger_delivery)
description:
Advanced collaborative robotics environment built on ROS 2 Jazzy. Integrates manipulation with a Kinova Gen3 arm, mobile robots, AprilTag-based visual perception, motion planning with MoveIt 2, and the integration of AI models (Gemini-Robotics) for semantic scene understanding.

Developed for teaching and applied research in the Mechatronics Engineering program at Universidad Militar Nueva Granada (Campus Cajica). The repository includes laboratory guides, conceptual material on MoveIt 2, and experimental reports on AI-based localization.

contributors.name: Mechatronics Engineering Students, Universidad Militar Nueva Granada
